a=[list(map(int,r.split())) for r in s.splitlines()]
from collections import deque, defaultdict
R=C=20
# graph components of 1 line cells; seed line nodes adjacent 3 or7
adj=lambda r,c:[(r+dr,c+dc) for dr,dc in [(1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)] if 0<=r+dr<R and 0<=c+dc<C]
# multi-source shortest distances per color in line graph initialized boundary contacts
D={3:{},7:{}}
for r in range(R):
 for c in range(C):
  if a[r][c]==1:
   for rr,cc in adj(r,c):
    if a[rr][cc] in (3,7):
     col=a[rr][cc]
     D[col][(r,c)]=0
for col in D:
 q=deque(D[col])
 while q:
  p=q.popleft()
  for n in adj(*p):
   if a[n[0]][n[1]]==1 and n not in D[col]:
    D[col][n]=D[col][p]+1;q.append(n)
out=[row[:] for row in a]
for r in range(R):
 for c in range(C):
  if a[r][c]==1:
   d3=D[3].get((r,c),999);d7=D[7].get((r,c),999)
   if d3<d7:out[r][c]=3
   elif d7<d3:out[r][c]=7
print('\n'.join(' '.join(map(str,row)) for row in out))
print('ties',sum(1 for r in range(R) for c in range(C) if a[r][c]==1 and D[3].get((r,c),999)==D[7].get((r,c),999)))
